title: Effects of Hypoxia or Caffeine on 4km Time-trial Morning Cycling.
official: Effects of Hypoxia or Caffeine on 4km Time-trial Morning Cycling.
summary: This study aims to implement a rigorously standardized protocol to investigate the effect of acute (60 min prior) caffeine intake or hypoxia (1000m and 2000m) on 4km time trial performance.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age: 18-30 years old
* Healthy (as determined by the pre-participation questionnaire)
* \>2 years aerobically trained individuals
* Consume \>150 mg/day of caffeine
* Be able to stick to the retiring and waking schedule of the study as well as no exercise 24 h before and no caffeine.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age: \<18 or \>30 years old
* Consume \<150 mg/day of caffeine hence caffeine naïve
* Those with a history of significant side effects after the consumption of caffeine.
* Deemed unhealthy/unable to perform exercise determined by PAR-Q
* Shift worker or having travelled out of the UK time zone within the last month of testing
* Muscle related injury or broken/fractured bone within the past 3 years Diagnosed sleep disorder
